label: Uneasy
summary: Monday opens with a surprise from Washington: President Trump announced an immediate energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine. Kyiv backed it but awaited details and guarantees; Moscow had not confirmed. Oil slipped on the news and US stock futures edged higher, though Brent remains near $100. The Gulf stays the heaviest weight: a second Houthi strike on Riyadh's airport killed one, and Tehran called Washington's reply to its Hormuz plan inadequate. North Korea fired ballistic missiles, an air strike killed at least 72 miners in Sudan, and Ebola is spreading in eastern Congo, with Kenya confirming an imported case. Hurricane Simon reached Category 4 off Mexico's Pacific coast. Brighter notes came from Brazil, where police freed 13 child hostages, and from labs reporting progress on fusion and glaucoma. The weighted formula gave 43; no editorial adjustment.
